properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 4 at 8:07PM CDT until August 6 at 8:10PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...Nueces River near Three Rivers.

* WHEN...Until Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 32.0 feet, The Nueces River backs up minor creeks to
near the slab elevation of homes in the River Creek Acres
Subdivision, five miles southeast of George West. Livestock are cut
off and could drown in low areas of the flood plain.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:15 PM CDT Tuesday the stage was 33.5 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 20.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage early
Thursday morning and continue falling to 9.0 feet Sunday evening.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.title: Dust Storm Warning issued August 4 at 5:57PM MST until August 4 at 7:30PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Dust Storm Warning for...
Northeastern Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 730 PM MST.

* At 557 PM MST, a wall of dust was located along a line from 11
miles northeast of Willcox to 17 miles north of Portal, moving
southwest at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Less than a quarter mile visibility.

SOURCE...Detected by National Weather Service meteorologists.

IMPACT...Dangerous life-threatening travel.

* Locations impacted include...
Willcox, Bowie, Dragoon, Chiricahua National Monument,
Pearce-Sunsites, Cochise, Sunizona, Kansas Settlement and San
Simon.

This includes the following highways...
Route 181 between mile markers 39 and 64. Route 191 between mile
markers 27 and 91. Interstate 10 between mile markers 322 and 390.
Route 186 between mile markers 327 and 359.
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not drive into a dust storm. PULL ASIDE STAY ALIVE!

Dust storms lead to dangerous driving conditions with visibility
reduced to near zero. If driving, avoid dust storms if possible. If
caught in one, pull off the road, turn off your lights and keep your
foot off the brake.

There is no safe place on a highway when a dust storm hits.
Visibility can be lost immediately, making it difficult or impossible
to slow down and avoid stopped vehicles. Delay travel, or safely exit
the highway before the dust storm arrives.

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued August 4 at 7:42PM EDT until August 4 at 11:45PM EDT by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
East Central Fannin County in north central Georgia...
Northeastern Gilmer County in north central Georgia...

* Until 1145 PM EDT.

* At 742 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Morganton, Dial, Pisgah, Cherry Log, Hurst and Hemp.
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.description:

The National Weather Service in El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Grant County in southwestern New Mexico...

* Until 830 PM MDT.

* At 529 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of
rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as
other poor drainage and low-lying areas.

Redrock and Gila Middle Box.

properties.instruction:

potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.

matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

properties.title: Air Quality Alert issued August 3 at 11:03AM MDT by NWS Missoula MT
properties.description:
AQAMSO

* WHAT...Air Quality Advisory due to smoke from wildfires.

Air Quality Index ranging from good to moderate, but is forecasted to degrade.

* WHERE...All Areas on the Nez Perce Reservation.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM Wednesday, August 5, 2026.

* IMPACTS...Those who experience health effects from smoke include
children under 18, elders, pregnant women, people with asthma
or have difficulty breathing, diabetes, heart problems or
otherwise compromised health, and people who have high exposure
(those who work, exercise, or spend extensive time outdoors).
properties.instruction:
Under the most severe pollution level, sensitive groups should avoid
outdoor exposure and limit indoor activities, and everyone should
restrict their outdoor activities.

health/wildfire-smoke
